Costs one field, changes NO grading behaviour, and stops every later census re-deriving a settled question. AND A STANDING HAZARD FOR ANY SEAT EDITING org/standards/NAMING_SCHEMA.json: types_not_graded_by_kind is a ROUTING TABLE, not an exclusion list -- lib/opal_naming.py:493 UNIONS it into graded_types, and the real switch at :1012 is str(why).startswith('NOT GRADED'), so REWORDING A REASON SILENTLY RE-GRADES A TYPE. Measured: 15 entries, 8 genuinely out, 7 still graded (EVENT_RULE, SCHEDULE, LOG_GROUP, S3_BUCKET, S3_BUCKET_POLICY, S3Key, SECRET). (d) THE SLUG-TIME GATE LIMB on .tools/surprise-row-gate.py, APPROVED IN PRINCIPLE AND NOT BUILT (R-66): refuse a slug when a GRADUATED item in the staged set carries NO remediation row. It needs its OWN CELL with a POSITIVE CONTROL (a compliant slug still passes) and a MUTANT (a planted rowless GRADUATED fails), because it holds REFUSAL POWER over every slug in the estate -- R-56 and R-61 are this session's lessons about exactly that, and R-62 is what happens when a mechanism is reached for without reading what it does. TWO INDEPENDENT FINDINGS CONVERGE ON THIS ONE LIMB (R-66 ADDENDUM @c120549127): (i) S74's structural finding -- an item whose clock was missed at round N's L10 can only acquire one at a LATER round's L10, so the backlog cannot drain itself; and (ii) 3.0.0_SA_CVO's first-firing report, that its own tick clause ('0 open orders AND undispositioned rows') CANNOT FIRE ON THE CASE IT WAS BUILT FOR, because zero-open is a state a project only reaches AT the L10 that was supposed to have dispositioned them. WHEN THIS LIMB EXISTS THE CVO'S CLAUSE BECOMES REDUNDANT RATHER THAN WRONG, and nothing in that cron body is edited mid-flight before then. AND A CORRECTION TO R-66 ITSELF: that ruling says the limb was 'recorded in the register beside (b) and (c)'. IT WAS NOT -- the register carried (b) and (c) only until this edit. DESIRED, NOT APPLIED, inside the very ruling whose subject is the state axis, and a round-8 cut reading this row would have found the limb ABSENT while the ruling asserted it PRESENT. The register is the carrier a cut READS (R-57); a ruling is not.
